tools.name: NVIDIA NIM
tools.status_notes: Free hosted endpoint availability is catalog/model-specific and changes over time.

authentication.notes: NVIDIA API key creation signs the user into or enrolls the user in the NVIDIA Developer Program; no reviewed official source stated a universal credit-card requirement.

tools.quota_summary: Free developer/prototyping access; universal quota undisclosed
tools.after_exhaustion: NVIDIA does not publish a universal hosted free quota or reset; free hosted API access is for prototyping and model availability is catalog-specific. Production use requires an NVIDIA AI Enterprise license.

trial.notes: NVIDIA AI Enterprise has a separate 90-day evaluation path; this record tracks the normal Developer Program hosted API/self-hosted development access, not that trial.

restrictions: The build.nvidia.com catalog labels Free Endpoint availability per model and changes over time; do not treat examples or catalog counts as a complete model list or quota.

deployment: Hosted NIM API endpoints are available through build.nvidia.com for prototyping and are hosted by NVIDIA on DGX Cloud.
The main LLM API endpoint is https://integrate.api.nvidia.com with POST /v1/chat/completions; build.nvidia.com examples use https://integrate.api.nvidia.com/v1 as the OpenAI client base URL.
Eligible NIM microservices can be downloaded and self-hosted on the user's own infrastructure under NVIDIA Developer Program terms.
runtime_limits: Self-hosted Developer Program NIM use is licensed for research, application development, and experimentation on up to 16 GPUs.
eligibility: NVIDIA Developer Program membership is required for free hosted endpoint prototyping and Developer Program NIM access.
NVIDIA AI Enterprise is separate from Developer Program access and is required for production use according to NVIDIA current docs.
notes: build.nvidia.com describes NIM as free serverless APIs for development and provides per-model Generate API Key/code snippets.
Do not treat API calls in the last 30 days or catalog model counts as a user quota.
Current Free Endpoint examples verified on 2026-09-09 include deepseek-ai/deepseek-v4-pro-0813, poolside/laguna-xs-2.1, and nvidia/nemotron-3.5-lightning-30b-a3b; availability is dynamic.
